encoder

This file defines a class used to create and manage encoder objects.

class encoder(tim, chA_pin, chB_pin)

A class that can be used to instantiate encoder objects.

Initialize the encoder object.

Parameters:

  • tim – Timer number used for encoder mode.

  • chA_pin – Pin connected to encoder channel A.

  • chB_pin – Pin connected to encoder channel B.

position

Total accumulated encoder count in ticks since the last zero().

delta

Change in encoder counts measured during the last update().

dt

Time interval in seconds between the two most recent update() calls.

tim

Hardware timer configured in encoder mode.

chA_pin

Pin connected to encoder channel A.

chB_pin

Pin connected to encoder channel B.

prev_count

Most recent raw timer counter value.

update(cbSRC=None)

Update the encoder count. This function is meant to be called periodically in a task or using a Timer

get_position()

Returns the current position of the encoder

Returns:

int The current position of the encoder in units of ticks

get_velocity()

Returns a measure of velocity using the the most recently updated value of delta as determined within the update() method

zero()

Zeros the encoder position at the current orientation. Used to reestablish a new datum position for the encoder
